setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.con: Corrections: small per-tick corrections, your keys always stand. Co-pilot (default): a jump at a locked block is held from takeoff to a stable landing; it fills keys you are not using and lets go of a key you held since before the jump, never one you just pressed. Takeover: hold a movement key toward the block and it flies the jump.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.ove: How quickly your own input takes a jump back. High: sooner. Low: the assist holds on longer. Sneak always hands everything back at once.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.lan: On a narrow landing (a fence post, a wall, a pane, a 1-block pillar) sneak from the last air tick, and every key you held through the jump stays off until you release it. Press a key again, jump or sneak and it is yours at once. Never while you hold jump.
setting.utilitysuite.movement_assist.hol: Fresh input: the sneak lifts once you stand still and press something new. Timer: it lifts after the limit below. Either way a key held through the jump stays off until you release it.
Ticks (50 ms each) the sneak stays on after you are stable before it lifts by itself.
